name: Kang Tae-oh
bio: Kang Tae-oh is a South Korean actor and singer. He is a member of 5urprise.

credits.title: The Intern
credits.overview: Ki-ho, a retiree with 37 years of experience, joins fashion start-up WOO22 a senior intern, he struggles with its digital, unconventional culture. Despite their differences, Ki-ho and Sun-woo, the start-up's young CEO, learn from each other and form an unexpected bond.

credits.title: Don't Buy the Seller
credits.overview: Soo-hyun, scammed by a broken washing machine, exposes the seller online. In retaliation, she's stalked and harassed, her life spiraling into chaos as her privacy vanishes and her home becomes unsafe.

credits.title: A Moment of Romance
